name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.42
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.42

### New Features
- Add Open in StraboMicro deep link button to web viewer header
- Add deep link open dialog and shared import helpers
- Register strabomicro:// protocol and deep link handling in main process

### Bug Fixes
- Match Open in StraboMicro button style to existing header buttons
- Register strabomicro:// protocol at Windows install time via NSIS include
- Exit second instance immediately to prevent splash flash and scratch cleanup race
- Ignore new deep links while one is already in flight
- Keep broken image elements out of Konva rendering


---

### Downloads

| Platform | Download |
|----------|----------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.42-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.42.dmg` |
| Windows | `StraboMicro2 Setup 2.0.42.exe` |
| Linux (AppImage) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.42.AppImage` |
| Linux (Debian) | `strabomicro2_2.0.42_amd64.deb` |

### Installation

**macOS**: Download the DMG, open it, and drag StraboMicro2 to your Applications folder.

**Windows**: Download and run the installer. If you see a SmartScreen warning, click "More info" then "Run anyway".

**Linux (AppImage)**: Download the AppImage, make it executable (`chmod +x`), and run with: `./StraboMicro2-*.AppImage --no-sandbox`

**Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)**: Install the .deb package: `sudo dpkg -i strabomicro2_*.deb`
